mapper.sql: CASE WHEN m.deleted != 1 THEN 'WITHDRAWN' WHEN COALESCE(m.login_restriction_days, 0) > 0 AND ( m.login_restricted_until IS NULL OR m.login_restricted_until > NOW() ) THEN 'LOGIN_RESTRICTED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member m
AND ( m.user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND m.role = #{role}
AND m.subscribe = #{subscribe}
AND m.deleted = 1 AND COALESCE(m.login_restriction_days, 0) = 0
AND m.deleted = 1 AND COALESCE(m.login_restriction_days, 0) > 0 AND ( m.login_restricted_until IS NULL OR m.login_restricted_until > NOW() )
AND m.deleted != 1

SELECT m.user_id AS userId, m.name AS name, m.email AS email, m.role AS role, m.subscribe AS subscribe, m.ai_count AS aiCount, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.deleted AS deleted, m.withdrawn_at AS withdrawnAt, m.login_restriction_days AS loginRestrictionDays, m.login_restricted_at AS loginRestrictedAt, m.login_restricted_until AS loginRestrictedUntil, m.login_restriction_reason AS loginRestrictionReason, m.login_restricted_by AS loginRestrictedBy, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report r WHERE r.reported_user_id = m.user_id ) AS reportReceivedCount, AS status FROM member m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET login_restriction_days = 0, login_restricted_at = NULL, login_restricted_until = NULL, login_restriction_reason = NULL, login_restricted_by = NULL WHERE COALESCE(login_restriction_days, 0) > 0 AND login_restricted_until IS NOT NULL AND login_restricted_until <= NOW() AND deleted = 1
UPDATE member SET ai_count = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_admin_action_history ( target_user_id, admin_user_id, report_id, action_type, action_reason, before_value, after_value, created_at ) VALUES ( #{targetUserId}, #{adminUserId}, #{reportId}, #{actionType}, #{actionReason}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, NOW() )
